idea-plugin.name: ReasonFlow
idea-plugin.description:
ReasonFlow IDE extension for JetBrains IDEs. This plugin provides comprehensive support for developing ReasonFlow workflows including:
  • Syntax highlighting for ReasonFlow workflow files
  • JSON schema validation for workflow definitions
  • Code completion for workflow elements
  • File type support for .reasonflow files
  • Quick documentation and error checking
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.0

  • Initial release
  • Support for ReasonFlow workflow files
  • JSON schema validation
  • Syntax highlighting and code completion
